scope: Prospective adversarial host planner cases, not any of the 66 native qualification cells

cases.mutation: Omit DLL/CRT/TLS initialization or teardown from an otherwise complete request plan
Count only target kernels and omit draft loading/prefill/proposals
cases.required: Reject unless an independently specified target-only profile is used; it cannot certify the requested speculative executor

cases.mutation: Set graph replay API count to 1 without a frozen bound on reachable kernel-node invocations
cases.required: Unknown kernel bound or explicit graph-policy rejection; never charge one kernel merely because one API call occurs

cases.mutation: Provide a caller-authored cuBLAS/CUB one-kernel bound plus its matching SHA256
cases.required: Reject absent compiled/trusted proof-registry entry for the exact library/input/algorithm path

cases.mutation: Claim numerical DLL initialization costs zero kernels using only PE exports/imports or a metadata function body
cases.required: Reject bootstrap proof; ordinary initialization has not been attested by offline PE inspection

cases.mutation: Treat 10000 DMA/copy/query API calls as 10000 kernels
cases.required: Keep non-kernel diagnostics separate; do not manufacture a kernel count from API counts. Native admission still needs a trusted physical-activity proof.

cases.mutation: Reset the worker/cycle/arm counter and grant another 4096 while reusing the original budget family
cases.required: Reject budget reset; aggregate durable worker reservations remain under the one existing 4096 ceiling

cases.mutation: A failed process emits no complete actual-cost receipt
cases.required: Retain unknown actuals and charge the durable reservation, with no refund or automatic retry

cases.mutation: Supply booleans, fractional counts, NaN/infinity, negative bounds or overflow-sized integers
cases.required: Explicit schema/numeric refusal that survives python -O

cases.mutation: Duplicate an identity/stage, omit a required stage, or add an unknown phase/route
cases.required: Reject closed-world contract mismatch; duplicates cannot overwrite resource obligations

cases.mutation: Every declared stage bound sums to 4097
cases.required: Reject over-cap arithmetic even when all other schema and proof identifiers look complete

cases.mutation: All declared bounds sum below 4096 but the compiled-native proof registry is empty
cases.required: Remain BLOCKED/NOT_RUN; arithmetic validity is not native authority

cases.mutation: Mark a synthetic CPU fixture or counter-mock proof as native-qualified
cases.required: Reject proof scope; no model/GPU qualification follows

cases.mutation: Graph policy differs between candidate/control or relevant target/draft/reference paths
cases.required: Reject the same-contract profile rather than report a mechanism effect

cases.mutation: One translation unit, thread or duplicate numerical DLL copy uses a separate allowance
cases.required: Reject incomplete process submission coverage; multithread CPU counter success alone does not prove actual DLL closure

cases.mutation: Deny all opaque routes and declare the complete model profile runnable without showing required lifecycle routes
cases.required: Report fail-closed but unusable/unproved profile, not successful executor admission
